editorialNote.en: The original is divided into meaning units. The other eight versions are new translations for this site, not copies of published translations. Translations, readings, notes and generated audio have not been reviewed by specialists. Wording and spelling follow the 1905 edition; the decorative opening E is represented as ordinary text. Only the speech input changes the preposition á to a. In the extension, the transcription’s “al pie de la tetra” is emended to “al pie de la letra” by comparison with Biblioteca Virtual Miguel de Cervantes. The illustration caption is excluded.

location.en: Part 1, Chapter 1, from “En un lugar de la Mancha” to the resolve to become a knight-errant, ending “eterno nombre y fama.”

ja.text: ラ・マンチャのある村に、その名を思い出す気はないのだが、ついこのあいだまで一人の郷士が住んでいた。槍掛けに槍、古い革盾、痩せた馬に足の速い猟犬を備える、あの手の郷士である。
